required_documents.name: Research.gov Proposal Package
required_documents.details: Standard NSF grant application submitted via Research.gov or Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Project Summary (Overview, Intellectual Merit, Broader Impacts)
required_documents.details: One-page project summary addressing Overview, Intellectual Merit, and Broader Impacts in separate labeled sections.

required_documents.name: Project Description
required_documents.details: Maximum 15-page project description detailing scientific rationale, research plan, work timeline, and broader impacts.

required_documents.name: Biographical Sketches (SciENcv format)
required_documents.details: Senior personnel biosketches generated via SciENcv conforming to NSF PAPPG format requirements.

required_documents.name: Budget and Budget Justification
required_documents.details: Itemized annual budget and detailed justification covering personnel salaries, participant support, and indirect costs.

required_documents.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan
required_documents.details: Up to 2 pages describing how the proposal will conform to NSF policy on the dissemination and sharing of research results.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Research.gov Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with Unique Entity Identifier and active institutional Research.gov accounts.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Broader Impacts (potential to benefit society and contribute to specific societal outcomes)

submission_limits: Institutional limits apply as detailed in the opportunity announcement; verify internal screening procedures.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity 24-573.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
